verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a Gumroad feature for user-defined rules or workflows that fire actions on events such as a sale or a new subscriber. Related items do not qualify. App connections ('thousands of apps') are third-party integrations rather than Gumroad's own rule engine. The REST API and MCP are developer building blocks. Automatic tax handling is a fixed platform behavior, not a user-defined rule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
